newsitem.title: USA: AlphaNet sees Q3 results above estimates.
newsitem.headline: AlphaNet sees Q3 results above estimates.

text.p: AlphaNet Solutions Inc said Thursday it expects to earn at least $0.18 a share on revenues of $30 million in the third quarter, compared with earnings of $0.15 a share on revenues of $18.5 million last year.
AlphaNet attributed its strong third quarter results to increased demand from its established customer base and new business related to a recent acquisition.
AlphaNet, which markets computer hardware and software products, expects to report its third quarter results on or about October 29.
